practiceSet.title: U7.LT2 Practice: DNA replication
practiceSet.description: Practice modeling and explaining DNA replication: helicase unzipping the strands, DNA polymerase building complementary strands by base pairing, primase and ligase on the lagging strand, semi-conservative copies, when and where replication happens, and counting copies.
